title: Ordinary decoding value lower bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with positive alphabet size $q$, and let a dictator-versus-no-influentials test family have predicate set $\Psi$, parameters $\alpha,\beta$, error function $\mathrm{error}$, and testers $T_n$ for each positive integer $n$. For any bounded long-code table $f$ on $G$, if $0<\varepsilon\le 1$ and $\alpha+\mathrm{error}(\varepsilon)+\tau$ is at most the value of $f$ under the averaged-neighbor tester $T_q$, then the ordinary decoding value of $f$ at threshold $\varepsilon$, with default label $0$, is at least $\tau\varepsilon/(8q^2)$.
